model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimuli types, visually representing the proportion of each type within a total. The chart is divided into eight categories, each represented by a distinct color: Social Media Post (light green, 1.5%), External News Article (dark green, 13.1%), Organizational Website (light blue, 6.6%), Interview (blue, 10.2%), Event Posting (purple, 8.8%), Organizational Report (magenta, 8.8%), Draft/Other (red, 28.5%), and Intra-agency News Article (pink, 0.7%). Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The chart includes a legend, with the label "Stimuli" prominently displayed toward the center, and the slices are ordered visually in descending size, from largest to smallest.
